item.title: Hegseth again looks to punish Democratic Sen. Mark Kelly over military comments
item.description: Hegseth said the Pentagon will review if Sen. Mark Kelly disclosed classified info in raising concerns about the strain the Iran war has placed on weapons stockpiles.

item.title: Surge of cartel violence in central Mexico forces between 800 and 1,000 families to flee homes
item.description: Community and human rights groups say between 800 and 1,000 families have been forced to flee their homes in the mountains of central Mexico as a criminal mafia attacks them with handmade explosive launched from drones and powerful weapons
